shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- package.json ---'; cat package.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- App.tsx ---'; cat src/App.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- main.tsx ---'; cat src/main.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- routing ---'; sed -n '1,160p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- theming traps ---'; rg -n -C 3 'ThemeProvider|theme|dark|light' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | sed -n '1,180p'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | sed -n '1,80p'; printf '\\n--- README setup/theme ---\\n'; rg -n -C 4 'ThemeProvider|Required setup|theme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | sed -n '1,180p'; printf '\\n--- ThemeProvider types ---\\n'; rg -n --glob '*.d.ts' -C 5 'ThemeProvider|ThemeProviderProps|type Theme|interface Theme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm | sed -n '1,220p'; printf '\\n--- radio/toggle/select declarations ---\\n'; rg -n 'interface RadioProps|interface SelectProps|declare const Select|declare const Radio' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/{Radio,Select}/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts; printf '\\n--- theme types ---\\n'; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- radio docs/types ---\\n'; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Radio/Radio.d.ts; printf '\\n--- segmented button types ---\\n'; sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedButton/SegmentedButton.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js; printf '\\n--- docs if bundled ---\\n'; if [ -f node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md ]; then rg -n -C 4 'system|ThemeProvider|className|scoped' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md | sed -n '1,160p'; fi"

/bin/bash -lc "for c in RadioGroup Toggle Switch Tabs; do printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$c"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/$c 2>/dev/null | head; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/$c -maxdepth 1 -name '"'*.d.ts' -print -quit 2>/dev/null | xargs -r sed -n '1,100p'; done"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/RadioGroup/RadioGroup.d.ts; printf '\\n--- switch ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; printf '\\n--- button ---\\n'; sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts"
